_meta.description: Receives Slack Events API webhooks, routes to correct agent by keywords. Import in n8n, activate, register at Slack App > Event Subscriptions.
_meta.routingLogic: keyword-based: code/bug→eng, security→infosec, cost/budget→finance, research→research, default→main
_meta.slackSetup: Slack App > Event Subscriptions > Request URL: https://<tunnel>/webhook/slack-inbound-router. Subscribe to: message.channels, app_mention.
